tagline.en: EPFL VITA's long-video model — extends image-to-video into extended, prompt-streamed clips by continuing motion clip after clip.
tagline.zh: EPFL VITA 的长视频模型——通过逐片续接运动，把图生视频扩展为更长、可按提示流生成的片段。

en: Stable Video Infinity 2.0 (SVI) is a long-video generation approach from the VITA lab at EPFL. Starting from an image-to-video base, it continues motion across successive clips so that short generations chain into a longer, coherent video.

It works by continuing motion frames from one clip into the next, padding with reference frames, and advancing through a stream of prompts — letting the content evolve over time. The runtime reuses Wan2.1's image-to-video components (its DiT, T5 and CLIP encoders, and VAE) plus the released SVI LoRA weights, giving each clip its own seed so successive segments differ.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — provide an input image and a prompt (or a stream of prompts), and it writes out an extended video, stitching the per-clip segments into one continuous H.264 output. The code is inference-only; Wan and SVI weights are resolved separately.
zh: Stable Video Infinity 2.0（SVI）是 EPFL VITA 实验室提出的长视频生成方法。它以图生视频为基座，在连续片段间续接运动，使多段短生成串联成一段更长、连贯的视频。
其做法是把一段片段的运动帧续接到下一段、用参考帧做填充，并沿着一串提示词推进——让内容随时间演化。运行时复用 Wan2.1 的图生视频组件（其 DiT、T5 与 CLIP 编码器以及 VAE），再加上已发布的 SVI LoRA 权重，并为每段片段分配独立随机种子，使各段之间产生差异。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline 运行它——提供一张输入图与提示词（或一串提示词），它就会输出一段扩展视频，把逐片段拼接为一条连续的 H.264 输出。其代码为纯推理；Wan 与 SVI 权重需单独获取。

whenToUse.en: When you want longer, coherent video that goes beyond a single short clip — driven from an image and evolved through a stream of prompts.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想生成超越单段短片、更长且连贯的视频——由一张图片驱动、沿一串提示词演化时。

notFor.en: Pure text-to-video from scratch — it starts from an input image. It also relies on separately staged Wan2.1 and SVI weights, so plan for the downloads and disk space.
notFor.zh: 不适合从零开始的纯文生视频——它以输入图片为起点。它还依赖单独部署的 Wan2.1 与 SVI 权重，请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。

en: Long, coherent video by continuing motion clip after clip
